verdict: Core model import succeeds with an isolated composite of pinned sources and a local roma package. A DINOv2 model state structure can be assembled on the meta device using a diagnostic replacement of the backbone factory and a tiny CPU linspace. Checkpoint compatibility, actual model allocation, GPU operator support, inference speed and output accuracy remain untested.

source_composite.method: Copies of independently staged pinned CroCo and DUSt3R; CroCo additionally copied into DUSt3R/croco to satisfy the actual upstream path helper. Every file hash of both copies matches the corresponding unmodified source; original third-party directories remain unchanged.

dependency.name: roma
dependency.method: Official PyPI pure-Python wheel matched PyPI hash, inspected archive paths, purelib flag, no native binaries, .pth or wheel scripts; pip --no-index --no-deps --no-compile to new isolated target. Existing venvs and scipy target not modified.

real_core_import.result: imported src.model with no path-loader monkeypatch; selected CroCo pure PyTorch RoPE fallback warning

meta_factory.result: constructed diagnostic meta model; 686 state tensors, 519695458 total elements, including 439 encoder state tensors; all state tensors on meta. No checkpoint loaded.
meta_factory.scoped_changes: get_backbone is replaced in this probe process only by upstream DinoV2Backbone wrapping Dinov2Model created from locally pinned config, avoiding from_pretrained. Default device meta cannot support original drop-path torch.linspace(...).item(), so only the 12-element linspace call is explicitly put on CPU; restored after construction. All model state tensors remain meta. No upstream source files edited.
meta_factory.failed_first_attempt: Unmodified get_model under global meta device failed with RuntimeError Tensor.item() cannot be called on meta tensors in src/model/calfvo.py drop-path linspace. The second diagnostic attempt adds the scoped CPU linspace override.
meta_factory.constraints: 30-second and 900 MiB sampled process-tree working-set termination guards; not hard OS-enforced resource limits. HF_HUB_OFFLINE and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE plus Python socket connect/create_connection blocked during meta construction. No real model weight tensors or device allocation, though normal CPU import/runtime and a 12-element CPU tensor do allocate memory.

next_admission: Before any full-checkpoint experiment separately assess disk, system commit, available VRAM, model and batch memory, license and source trust; acquire only the selected verified checkpoint if authorized. Verify strict state keys/shapes and reference-equivalent preprocessing/windows before any interpretation. Model output and learned metric scale need independent held-out validation, particularly for game footage.
non_actions: No model or backbone weights downloaded; no inference, device input, setup script, changes to product code, original source copies, existing venv or shared target.
